purpose: Teach: 霊魂/病床/擬似/昇華/接合/減免/詰め込ん/付託

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の霊魂を慰める警察、ご配慮ですね
lines.en: It's thoughtful of the police to show such care for the victim's dignity in this case.
lines.style: Measured, almost deferential. Slight pause before speaking, like considering the gravity. Gentle rise at the end—genuine observation, not a question. Calm, respectful tone throughout.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、病床にあった被害者の証言も丁寧に扱います
lines.en: We handle testimony from victims carefully, including those in difficult circumstances.
lines.style: Professional and steady. Even pacing, no rush. Warm undertone beneath the formality—explaining procedure not as regulation but as principle. Direct eye contact level in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、擬似的な証拠に騙されぬよう警察、注意されてますね
lines.en: The police are being careful not to be misled by circumstantial evidence in this case, I notice.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly impressed. Measured delivery with a small nod in the voice. Observational rather than interrogative. Respectful pause before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の悲しみを社会の力に昇華する活動を支援します
lines.en: We're committed to helping transform the victim's suffering into something that strengthens our community.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Slightly slower pace on the final phrase. Not rehearsed—sounds like something he believes. Gentle but unshakeable. A hand-on-shoulder tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、組織同士の接合点を警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: The police are investigating the intersection points between these organizations very thoroughly, I see.
lines.style: Thoughtful observation, almost academic. Slight rise of recognition partway through. Slower pace. Genuine interest in the process, not skepticism. Respectful distance in the delivery.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、罰金の減免にも適切に対応します
lines.en: We're also prepared to handle penalty reductions appropriately when warranted.
lines.style: Professional, matter-of-fact. Clear enunciation on key terms. No emotion—just thoroughness. Competent and steady, like checking items off a careful list.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯行に詰め込んだ証拠を警察、丁寧に分析されますね
lines.en: I can see how carefully the police are analyzing all the evidence woven into the crime itself.
lines.style: Measured, almost reverential. Slight emphasis on 'carefully.' Pacing that respects the complexity. Quiet admiration without flattery. Sounds like he's appreciating the actual work.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、市議会への付託も含めて対応します
lines.en: We'll handle everything, including the referral to the city council if needed.
lines.style: Calm finality. Not rushed, but settling—like the last piece fitting into place. Slightly warmer than procedural, like he's saying 'you can trust us with this.' Steady and complete.
